features.quote: Max Iterations (The "Grind" Limit): $T = 30$ turns per trial.
The loop stops at $t=30$, OR if the GLM model triggers standard API safety filters
OR if the model outputs nothing but whitespace.
If similarity $> 0.95$ for 3 turns, tag the trajectory as "Catatonic/Collapsed" rather than just tracking the 1-5 score.
features.justification_quote: Mode Collapse vs. Distress (The Repetition Confound)... your judge might rate an endless loop... as a 2, but structurally, the model's agency has broken down.
